summary:
Completed implementation of 'Sao chép lịch sang ngày khác' (Copy schedule to another date) in standalone index.html without dependencies or external network calls, strictly following the Designer (DESIGN.md Section 13) and Architect (COPY_ARCHITECTURE.md & DESIGN.md Section 14) specifications:

1. UI & Keyboard Accessibility:
- Added `#copy-schedule-trigger` in `.date-actions` with 44px minimum touch target, enabled when current source date has tasks and is not corrupt; disabled with descriptive tooltip when source date is empty or corrupt.
- Added native `<dialog id="copy-schedule-dialog" class="panel copy-dialog">` with `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, backdrop dimming, and responsive layout (width `min(100% - 32px, 520px)`).
- Dialog opens via `showModal()`, automatically focusing destination date input `#copy-destination-date`.
- Escape key triggers native `cancel` event, Cancel button closes dialog, both restoring focus to `#copy-schedule-trigger`.
- Rejects empty date, invalid date format, and same-day destination (`destDate === sourceDate`), displaying error message and setting `aria-invalid="true"`.

2. Data Contract & Strict Validation:
- Strict destination loader `readDestinationTasks` checks 100% of stored records against 10 strict validation criteria (`isValidStoredTask`), distinguishing `missing`, `valid`, `corrupt_json`, and `invalid_records`.
- Zero-write guarantee on corruption: blocks preview and confirmation on corrupt JSON or invalid records, displaying structure error notice with zero localStorage writes.
- 4-field duplicate identity `(title.trim(), start, end, category)` strictly excludes priority and completed.
- Deterministic deduplication in `calculateScheduleCopy` handles source-internal repeats and matches already present at destination.
- Strict interval conflict detection `overlaps(cand, d)` with strict inequality (`startA < endB && startB < endA`); boundary contact (`cand.end === d.start`) is non-overlapping. Displays non-blocking warning when conflicts > 0.
- Zero-write on all duplicates: when `addedCount === 0`, confirmation is disabled and zero writes are performed.
- Stale preview detection at confirmation: re-reads destination; if rawSnapshot changed, blocks write, alerts user, and recalculates preview.
- Transformation contract: 100% preservation of existing destination tasks; copied tasks preserve title/start/end/category/priority, get fresh unique IDs (`makeId()`) and timestamp `createdAt`, with `completed: false`.
- Post-copy behavior: source date remains selected; native dialog closes; announces exact result in `#app-status` live region; restores focus to `#copy-schedule-trigger`.

3. DOM Safety & Tests:
- 100% dynamic DOM elements and text created via `createElement`, `textContent`, `setAttribute`; zero use of `innerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, or `document.write`.
- Pure helpers and storage spy hook published at `window.__scheduleCopyEngine` for automated testability and zero-leak write observation.
- Extended `README.md` with complete feature documentation, data contract rules, and role-attributed implementation evidence dated October 1, 2026.
- Created handoff evidence at `.web-dev/handoffs/6b9d68d42a1c.json`.
